summary: Iteration 40 – PDF-Rechnungs-Archiv (Hetzner S3) + Visual/Text changes. 12/12 backend pytest PASS, all 4 frontend visual checks PASS. PDF archive workflow verified end-to-end: first GET builds+uploads to saferide/invoices/{number}-{iid}.pdf, second GET streams byte-identical PDF from archive (md5 match), ?force=true regenerates, PATCH of non-status/payment_method field clears archive_path/archive_url (verified via price PATCH → both empty strings), PATCH of only status or only payment_method preserves archive_path. Footer bottom bar reorganised: CMS Login now LEFT of copyright (x=349 vs Impressum x=1081 on desktop; on tablet 768px: admin x=349/w=60, WhatsApp bubble x=676 — no overlap). WhySafeRide section renders bg-coral-strong (linear-gradient rgb(255,156,122)→rgb(245,106,77)→rgb(220,74,48)), all 6 pillar boxes are bg-[#fbf9f6] off-white (Mental-Coaching pillar no longer dark). 3 About-Speedos completely removed from DOM. Dog image (img[alt=Nadines Hund]) rendered with h-[180px] md:h-[220px] object-cover. wp1 body_de = 'Ich bin Nadine – keine anonyme Fahrschule, keine Lehrer-Rotation. Persönliche Begleitung von der ersten Lektion bis zum Führerausweis.' (134 chars, 2 sentences).
critical_code_review_comments: student_invoices.export_invoice_pdf: put_object() and get_object() (boto3 sync) are called from an async endpoint without asyncio.to_thread — same issue flagged in iter39. Under bursts this briefly blocks the event loop.

student_invoices.update_invoice: invalidate_archive logic is correct but silently ignores potential race — if two admins PATCH the same invoice concurrently while one is downloading a PDF, the invoice could end up with archive fields pointing to a still-uploading blob. Not a bug per se, but worth documenting.

student_invoices.export_invoice_pdf: when force=true and put_object() throws, the code silently swallows the exception (pass in except). The user still gets a valid PDF, but the archive is left stale/unchanged with no server log — recommend at minimum a logger.warning() here.

student_invoices.export_invoice_pdf: on archive read failure ('except Exception: pass'), the stale archive_path is NOT cleared. Next call will keep trying the missing S3 object forever until a PATCH invalidates it. Consider clearing archive_path in the DB when get_object throws NoSuchKey.

InvoicesTab.jsx line 41: backendBase resolved once at module load; ok in CRA but worth noting that the archive link is a plain <a href> and points to /api/files/... (auth-free file endpoint) — target='_blank' opens in a new tab without credentials. Verified that GET /api/files/... is admin-independent (public). Good.

About.jsx: There are now TWO dog images on the page. The upper one (line 66-73, path='about.dog_image_url', 180-220px height, replacing the 3 Speedos) and the lower one (line 118, path='about.dog_photo_url', 220-300px, in a caption slot). Spec called for a single Hunde-Foto — main agent may want to consolidate or rename to avoid confusion between dog_image_url and dog_photo_url.

WhySafeRide.jsx: ACCENTS[i%6] still has `bg` implied via truthiness (`const dark = !!a.bg`). Since none of the 6 accents now define a.bg, `dark` is always false — safe but the branch code (the `${a.bg} ${a.fg}` template + editMode dark styling on trash icon) is dead. Cleanup opportunity.
wp1 body_de is 134 chars including a UTF-8 en-dash — displayed cleanly in the pillar box (~2 lines at desktop / ~3 lines at mobile). Requirement ('unter 5 Zeilen') met.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (4/4 visual checks + Archive icon UI + tablet WhatsApp non-overlap)

context_for_next_testing_agent: PDF-Archive workflow is LIVE. Storage path: saferide/invoices/{number}-{iid}.pdf. Archive fields on StudentInvoice: archive_path, archive_url (=/api/files/{path}), archived_at (ISO). Footer CMS Login is data-testid=footer-admin-link, order-2 md:order-1 (left on desktop, second row on mobile). WhySafeRide section uses class bg-coral-strong (custom CSS in index.css line 294-297). About section replaced 3 Speedos with img[alt='Nadines Hund'] bound to path='about.dog_image_url' (default Unsplash URL when unset). NOTE: About.jsx has BOTH dog_image_url (new, top) and dog_photo_url (existing, bottom) — two dog images on the same page currently.
rca of the issue: N/A – no bugs discovered. All spec items match expected behaviour. Minor code-quality notes captured under critical_code_review_comments (dead code branch in WhySafeRide ACCENTS, missing logger.warning on archive failure paths, two dog-image slots on the About page).
